items.issue: An identifiable participant's face and a real-world approach are published; filming and publication authorization are not established by the clip.
items.disposition: Keep research-only unless authorization and a suitable privacy treatment are resolved; do not package identifiable frames by default.

items.issue: The male camera operator is never visible, so channel branding alone does not independently prove that he is Mikey.
items.disposition: Attribute him as the male camera operator editorially presented as Mikey; do not upgrade to certain first-person Mikey evidence.

items.issue: Phone handling is visible, but the account, operation and successful WeChat addition are not readable or continuously shown.
items.disposition: Record only that a brief phone interaction occurs before mutual goodbye; do not claim a successful number close or later contact.

items.issue: The title can encourage pursuing a person who does not stop, while the participant's earphone explanation is known only after she engages.
items.disposition: Do not generalize this case into permission to chase, block, touch or repeatedly pressure a non-responsive person; preserve an easy exit and stop when disinterest is clear.

items.issue: No parent long-form source or complete unedited approach was located.
items.disposition: Keep provisional and re-run visual/transcript dedup and context review if the parent appears.
